title: Zero-Downtime Deployment with Slots
description: Use a staging slot with warm-up so a swap never serves errors or cold-start latency.

data.text: Every deployment causes 30-60 seconds of 500 errors followed by a minute of very slow requests. The team has tried deploying at 3 a.m. to hide it. Users in other time zones still notice. Fix the deployment process.

Deploy to a **staging slot**, not production. Configure **application initialization** (`WEBSITE_SWAP_WARMUP_PING_PATH`) so App Service waits for the new instance to be genuinely ready before traffic arrives, then perform a **slot swap**. The swap is near-instant because it only updates routing rules. Crucially, ensure your app tolerates a swap: no in-memory session state, no instance-local file writes.

data.title: Warm-up path plus slot swap
data.code:
- task: AzureWebApp@1
  displayName: Deploy to staging slot
  inputs:
    azureSubscription: quotient-prod-connection
    appName: app-quotient-prod
    deployToSlotOrASE: true
    resourceGroupName: rg-quotient-prod
    slotName: staging
    package: $(Pipeline.Workspace)/drop
    appSettings: |
      -WEBSITE_SWAP_WARMUP_PING_PATH "/health/ready"
      -WEBSITE_SWAP_WARMUP_PING_STATUSES "200"
      -ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT "Production"

- task: AzureAppServiceManage@0
  displayName: Swap staging into production
  inputs:
    azureSubscription: quotient-prod-connection
    Action: 'Swap Slots'
    WebAppName: app-quotient-prod
    ResourceGroupName: rg-quotient-prod
    SourceSlot: staging

data.title: Readiness endpoint that actually checks dependencies

data.text: Keep two separate probes: **liveness** answers "is the process running?" and must be cheap; **readiness** answers "can this instance serve requests?" and may check SQL and storage. Conflating them means a transient SQL blip restarts every healthy instance.

In-place deployment overwrites files under a running process, so some requests hit a half-updated application. Slots give you a fully running, warmed-up second copy; the swap itself is a routing change measured in seconds, and the previous version stays in the staging slot as an instant rollback target.

cards.title: Staging slot + warm-up + swap
pros: Can validate in production config at staging hostname
cons: Requires stateless app and shared session store
